name: João Dias
headline: Cybersecurity & Network Specialist

site.heroRole: SOC analyst in Lisbon. I triage security alerts for national critical infrastructure.
about: I work in a security operations center. I triage alerts and escalate the real incidents, within strict response times.
Before that I built the other side: Active Directory, firewalls, VPNs and endpoint management. I learned it in a two-year cybersecurity specialization and finished with 18/20.
I automate repeated work with Python, PowerShell and AI agents.

points: Monitor and analyze security alerts in a SIEM to triage threats across large-scale critical infrastructure.
Support incident response and escalation for a national public-safety network.
Work under strict confidentiality and SLA-driven response times.

projects.title: Enterprise endpoint management
projects.summary: Chose, designed and deployed a central endpoint management platform joined to Active Directory.
points: Evaluated endpoint management solutions and wrote a comparison with a recommendation.
Designed the high-level and low-level architecture, integrated with the AD domain.
Deployed software distribution, patch management and system monitoring modules.

projects.title: Network infrastructure design
projects.summary: Segmented network with a DMZ, pfSense firewalls and site-to-site VPN.
points: Designed VLAN segmentation, DMZ architecture and access control policies.
Configured pfSense firewalls with NAT/PAT and port rules.
Documented site-to-site VPNs (IPsec and OpenVPN), network diagrams and procedures.

projects.title: High-availability infrastructure
projects.summary: Active Directory with redundant domain controllers, a GPO baseline and DPM backups.
points: Built an AD domain with redundant domain controllers.
Defined Group Policy Objects for the organization's configuration baseline.
Assessed backup options and implemented Data Protection Manager (DPM).

Ran stress tests and edge-case tests, and documented performance.
